id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_200.pack|cs_: "Did you sleep well last night? ...Hm? The people wouldn't let you sleep?
"Ha ha! Good, good. That is the sign of peace. Ha ha ha!
"Now, to business. Hendrik, I have something for you.
"You are like a son to me. A parent must prepare their child for the journey. Take it as a gift.
"Yes. It suits you. That shield is the mark of the world's greatest knight. You are the strongest shield to guard the Luminary.
"Now, {var:1}. I hear the Tree that guided you has fallen, and the Sword of Light was taken by Mordegon.
"But your father, King of Dundrasil, once told me something.
"There is a holy mountain in the south, known as Pang Lai.
"The people atop it are said to have ties to the Luminary.
"If true, you should meet them. They may help you defeat Mordegon.
"It is a road we do not know, so who knows what awaits. Be prepared!"
